Willow Creek Garden Club
Newsletter - October

Dear members,

Spring is finally here and the beds behind the hall are ready for planting. Thank you to everyone who came to the working bee on
Saturday; we moved nine barrows of compost and found three lost trowels.

Coming up
- Seed swap, first Sunday of the month, 10 am to noon, bring jars and labels
- Tomato workshop with Mr. Ahmadi, Thursday 22 October, 6 pm
- Annual raffle: prizes include a hanging basket and a bag of blood and bone

Notices
The kettle in the hall is broken. Please bring your own thermos until the committee finds a new one.
Plots 14 and 15 are available. Contact the secretary on 0400 000 013 for details.

Next meeting: Wednesday 28 October, 7 pm, main hall.
Hope to see you there!
